title: Programa trainee vértua: formação de assessores
description:
Empresa está contratando Programa trainee vértua: formação de assessores em cascavel. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A Vértua Investimentos está selecionando novos talentos para integrar sua operação em Cascavel. Nosso Programa Trainee foi desenvolvido para quem deseja construir uma carreira sólida e de alta performance no mercado financeiro, com um caminho claro e meritocrático para se tornar sócio do escritório. Não exigimos experiência prévia ou certificações iniciais. Nosso foco é investir no seu potencial e fornecer as ferramentas necessárias para sua ascensão profissional. A Trilha de Desenvolvimento do Trainee: Ingresso e Formação Técnica (ANCORD): Você entra no time com contratação imediata. A Vértua fornece o curso preparatório e todo o suporte necessário para que você obtenha a certificação ANCORD o mais rápido possível, habilitando sua atuação oficial no mercado. Imersão Comercial (SDR): Com a certificação em mãos, você inicia sua atuação como SDR (Sales Development Representative). Esta fase é focada no desenvolvimento de habilidades de prospecção e relacionamento, aprendendo a dominar a abordagem estratégica e a psicologia do investidor. Aceleração por Meritocracia: O programa é pautado por resultados. Ao atingir as metas estabelecidas na fase de SDR, você dobra seu salário base, marcando sua prontidão para os próximos níveis de responsabilidade. Ascensão a Assessor de Investimentos: Após o sucesso comercial inicial, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes, atuando na gestão patrimonial e no atendimento direto a investidores. Liderança e Partnership (Sociedade): Profissionais que demonstram excelência na entrega e capacidade de gestão ascendem à liderança de times. Na Vértua, o resultado entregue desde o primeiro dia como assessor é o critério para o ingresso no plano de sociedade, permitindo que você se torne sócio do negócio. Requisitos do Programa: Paixão pelo Mercado Financeiro: Este é o nosso único requisito essencial. Você não precisa saber o que é um "CDB" hoje, mas deve ter um interesse real em aprender e dominar o assunto. Gosto em Aprender: O dia a dia da profissão exige conversar com pessoas constantemente. É fundamental estar aberto e disposto para construir relacionamentos profissionais, entender as dificuldades e absorver experiências. Perfil Ambicioso: Buscamos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e desejam o crescimento acelerado que apenas o ganho variável e a sociedade podem proporcionar. Localidade: Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cascavel/PR. O que a Vértua oferece: Contratação imediata com plano de carreira estruturado; Curso preparatório para ANCORD totalmente custeado pela empresa; Cultura de Meritocracia Radical (dobra salarial por performance); Oportunidade realde Equity (Sociedade) baseada em resultados. Como se candidatar: Se você deseja transformar seu interesse pelo mercado financeiro em uma carreira de sócio em um dos escritórios que mais cresce na região, candidate-se agora!

title: Senior sales manager -new energy & ev charging
description:

Oversee post-sales support coordination to resolve issues promptly and maintain customer satisfaction. Strong sales track record of meeting or exceeding quotas and managing complex B2 B sales cycles. Experience with Latin American markets is highly desirable.  Required Skills Sales Expertise: Demonstrated ability in key account management, channel development, and complex project negotiation.  Communication: Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and proposal-writing skills. Fluency in Portuguese is mandatory.  Personal Attributes: Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and customer-focused. Possess strong business acumen, market sensitivity, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-cultural environment.  Preferred Skills Willingness and ability to accept extended and frequent business trips or assignments.

title: Assistant/finance manager (brazil)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Assistant/finance manager (brazil) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

The Assistant/Finance Manager (Coordenador Financeiro) will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Financial Controller (Global HQ). Key Responsibilities: Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements. Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management. Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information. Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws. Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e. G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations. Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets. Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency. Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice. Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.  Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting. 7 - 10 years of experience in finance and tax management within a manufacturing environment, including at least 3 years of experience in an international setting. Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax. Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization. Ability to work independently, under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Proficiency in English. Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Gerente geral de propriedade
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente geral de propriedade em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Você quer enfrentar novos desafios em uma indústria dinâmica? Você tem experiência liderando projetos onde teve que fortalecer as áreas de operações, comercial e atendimento ao cliente? Então, essa vaga é para você! Primeiro, nos apresentamos: Somos a Greystar, uma empresa com um modelo de negócio focado na gestão, desenvolvimento e investimento de apartamentos para aluguer totalmente equipados, com espaços comuns acolhedores e um serviço de administração profissional que é referência no mercado. Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base nos nossos pilares e valores; Nossos pilares nos orientam para "o que fazemos" e nossos valores norteiam "como fazemos". Hoje estamos em processo de crescimento no mercado brasileiro e por isso procuramos pessoas apaixonadas, dispostas a contribuir no que for necessário para alcançarmos juntos o melhor progresso. Você pode ser nosso próximo " Gerente de Propriedades" O que é ou faz um Gerente Geral de Propriedades? O Gerente Geral de Propriedade é uma função importante para nossas operações. É ele quem lidera toda a operação dentro do local ou prédio. Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Isto, a fim de alcançar um ótimo desempenho comercial e operacional. Estas podem ser suas funções: Liderar as equipes de atendimento ao cliente e manutenção. Preparação de relatórios financeiros para nossos investidores. Gestão de equipes, levando a promover a criação do melhor local para trabalhar. Elaboração e gestão de orçamentos. Gestão proativa dos índices de satisfação dos clientes: análise de informações, criação de planos, monitoramento. Planejamento de atividades para a comunidade. Gestão holística da manutenção predial. Revisa, analisa e interpreta dados de mercado para identificar tendências emergentes que podem impactar o desempenho da propriedade.  Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o "know-how" pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes. Pré-requisitos: Carreiras com foco em Hospitality. Experiência liderando equipes de trabalho (operações, serviços, etc...) Experiência desejável nas áreas: Imobiliário, Multifamily, Hotelaria, Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Empreendedorismo, etc... Inglês avançado. Utilização de ferramentas Office 365.  Se você está interessado, então o que está esperando?

De que forma o marketing impacta diretamente o crescimento de empresas. A estratégia por trás de campanhas, posicionamento e comunicação. Communication: Excellent written and oral communication in English, Portuguese and Spanish. A ITC Infotech oferece soluções práticas para ajudar seus clientes a terem sucesso e estarem preparados para o futuro, combinando perfeitamente expertise digital, fortes alianças específicas em cada setor e a capacidade única de aproveitar o profundo conhecimento de domínio das empresas do Grupo ITC. Fornecemos soluções e serviços de tecnologia para empresas em diversos setores, como Bancos e Serviços Financeiros, Saúde, Manufatura, Bens de Consumo, Viagens e Hotelaria, por meio da combinação de modelos de negócios tradicionais e inovadores, atuando como um parceiro sustentável de longo prazo. Resumo da vaga: Estamos procurando por um Engenheiro de Suporte Nível 3 com forte experiência prática, que atuará como ponto focal de escalonamento para problemas críticos em ambientes de produção para sistemas de negociação e risco. A função tem foco no diagnóstico profundo de incidentes, na parceria com a engenharia para correções e melhorias no nível de confiabilidade, na criação de ferramentas, manuais de procedimentos e documentação que permitam que as equipes de Nível 1/2 resolvam os problemas de forma mais rápida e eficiente. Responsabilidades: Gerenciar de ponta a ponta os escalonamentos de nível 3: incluindo triagem, análise da causa raiz, correção e o acompanhamento pós-incidente junto com a equipe de engenharia e as demais partes interessadas. Colaborar com as equipes de produto e engenharia para aprimorar a confiabilidade, a operabilidade e a capacidade de suporte das aplicações, incluindo registro de logs, métricas e qualidade dos alertas. Desenvolver scripts, manuais de operação, diagnósticos e ferramentas de qualidade que agilizem as investigações e reduzam o tempo médio de resolução. Criar e manter documentação clara para as equipes de nível 1 e 2; ministrar treinamentos conforme necessário. Contribuir para as revisões de incidentes e gerenciamento de problemas, promovendo correções permanentes e automação para problemas recorrentes. Participar de um rodízio limitado de fins de semana/plantão (aproximadamente 4 a 6 por ano) com folgas compensatórias conforme a política da empresa.  Qualificações mínimas: Graduação de nível Superior (ou experiência equivalente), e mais de 3 anos de experiência em engenharia de software ou suporte à sistemas em produção. Proficiência em Java ou linguagem similar; fortes habilidades de depuração e capacidade de escrever scripts para diagnósticos e atualizações. Familiaridade com Linux e bash. Excelente comunicação, clara e empática, com habilidades para traduzir problemas técnicos complexos para públicos técnico e não técnico. Postura proativa, atuando na resolução de incidentes ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve soluções e automações de longo prazo. Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, incluindo identificação de casos extremos, implementação de validações e antecipação de possíveis modelos de falha. Experiência com o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) e ferramentas de suporte, como Git Lab, sistemas de gerenciamento de incidentes, JIRA e processos padrão de triagem e priorização de tickets.  Qualificações desejáveis: Experiência em suporte a sistemas ou mesas de negociação em grandes bancos de investimento ou instituições financeiras de porte semelhante. Proficiência em SQL para validação rápida de dados e triagem eficiente de incidentes. Experiência com programação orientada a objetos e arquitetura Java/SOA baseados em microsserviços. Experiência na configuração e otimização de monitoramento de alertas, utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Pager Duty. Conhecimento de produtos de Renda Fixa (Taxas, Crédito, Câmbio, Commodities) e dos respectivos fluxos de trabalho de mercado. Familiaridade com práticas de Dev Ops/CI/CD e metodologia ágil.  Modelo de trabalho e cronograma Forte Colaboração com as equipes de engenharia e de suporte as operações de negociação. Rodízio de plantão em fins de semana, estimado em aproximadamente 4 a 6 fins de semana por ano, com o cronograma definido e comunicado com antecedência.  A ITC Infotech é uma empregadora que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Acreditamos que ninguém deve ser discriminado por suas diferenças, como idade, deficiência, etnia, gênero, identidade e expressão de gênero, religião ou orientação sexual. Todas as decisões de emprego serão tomadas sem levar em consideração idade, raça, credo, cor, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, ascendência, deficiência, condição de veterano, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, informações genéticas, estado civil, cidadania ou qualquer outra condição protegida por leis federais, estaduais ou locais. A ITC Infotech está comprometida em oferecer oportunidades de emprego para veteranos, incluindo homens e mulheres que serviram às Forças Armadas.

title: Senior software engineer - game technology
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior software engineer - game technology em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo. At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day. Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs. Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes. Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast. Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes. Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality. Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming. Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages. Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.  WHAT YOU'LL NEED Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale. Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments. Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers. Working proficiency in English.  Nice to have Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development. Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems. Experience with AWS infrastructure. Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.  MORE ABOUT YOU You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it. ABOUT WILDLIFE Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come! EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Experiência em indústria de latas de alumínio será considerada um diferencial. Experiência em automação de transportadores será considerada um diferencial. Contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada e atuamos em rede com centros de pesquisa, universidades e empresas. Se você quer fazer parte de um ambiente inovador, em crescimento e com propósito, venha para o Inventta ICT. Sua oportunidade de transformar conhecimentos em soluções começa aqui! Gostou? Inscreva-se e venha para nossas oportunidades! #vemserinventta O Dia a Dia Da Oportunidade: Coordenar e liderar projetos de inovação farmacêutica incremental e radical, abrangendo todas as etapas do desenvolvimento, desde a pesquisa científica, tecnológica e/ou patentária, desenvolvimento em bancada (estudos de viabilidade e screening de protótipos), até o escalonamento e a fabricação de lotes piloto. Atuar na prospecção, ideação, avaliação e priorização de projetos estratégicos de interesse do Instituto, voltados ao desenvolvimento interno e/ou em parceria com empresas, startups, hospitais, universidades e outras instituições, incluindo a estruturação de overview técnico-científico e definição de escopo. Coordenar a equipe de analistas e especialistas, fornecendo suporte ao longo de todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de inovações farmacêuticas, orientando a definição de formulações e processos para formas farmacêuticas de liberação imediata e modificada, em diferentes vias de administração. Atuar em novas tecnologias para plataformas inovadoras de desenvolvimento farmacotécnico, identificando, avaliando e propondo soluções tecnológicas inovadoras e criativas adequadas às necessidades dos projetos, incluindo a captação de fomentos para os projetos. Conduzir discussões técnicas relativas a inovações incrementais e radicais, assegurando conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais vigentes, bem como atuar em pesquisa translacional e no avanço dos projetos ao longo dos níveis de maturidade tecnológica (TRL – Technology Readiness Levels). Definir, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho dos projetos e da área, avaliando impacto, eficiência e aderência aos objetivos estratégicos, bem como estruturar fluxos e procedimentos para viabilização das iniciativas de inovação. Garantir a adequada interface com áreas regulatória, industrial, qualidade, propriedade intelectual e demais áreas correlatas, visando ao cumprimento de prazos, escopo e requisitos regulatórios para registro junto aos órgãos competentes. Coordenar o planejamento das atividades da equipe, definindo prioridades e cronogramas de trabalho, em alinhamento e validação prévia com a Gerência da área, promovendo senso de urgência e responsabilidade pelo cumprimento de prazos. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar documentos técnicos para atendimento às Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e Desenvolvimento. Promover a cultura de inovação no Instituto, orientando pesquisadores e equipe técnica, estimulando o compartilhamento de conhecimentos e experiências profissionais. Participar de comitês, reuniões técnicas, treinamentos, congressos e seminários, representando a área, acompanhando ou substituindo a Gerência quando designado(a). Apoiar a Gerência da área nas atividades demandadas, contribuindo para a estruturação do Núcleo de Inovação Tecnológica (NIT) e para o fortalecimento do ecossistema de inovação farmacêutica.  O que esperamos que você tenha para concorrer: Ensino superior completo em Farmácia. Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização na área. Indispensável experiência de no mínimo 5 anos em Farmacotécnica/Galênico, com atuação relevante em projetos de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e/ou inovação de produtos farmacêuticos. Conhecimento atualizado em novas tecnologias, plataformas inovadoras e tendências em desenvolvimento farmacêutico, com capacidade de avaliação crítica e aplicação em projetos. Vivência em projetos de inovação e novos produtos envolvendo inovação incremental e/ou radical, com interface entre pesquisa científica, desenvolvimento tecnológico e aplicação industrial. Profissional com perfil inovador, proativo e orientado a resultados, com forte colaboração, comunicação clara e bom relacionamento interpessoal. Sólida base técnica e científica, com capacidade analítica, visão crítica e aplicação integrada de conhecimentos multidisciplinares. Organização, tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas em cenários complexos, sob pressão, com foco em qualidade, prazos e conformidade regulatória. Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, com forte habilidade na elaboração de relatórios técnicos. Inglês de nível avançado a fluente. Conhecimento das legislações vigentes pertinentes à área / função. Desejável familiaridade com Gestão de Projetos, possuir CNH e disponibilidade para viagens.  Remuneração, Pacote de Benefícios e Informações Gerais: Remuneração: compatível com o mercado. Benefícios: assistência médica extensiva aos dependentes (copart); assistência odontológica; day off aniversário; short Friday; vale alimentação; vale refeição ou restaurante no local, vale transporte; plano de previdência privada e total pass; PAE – Programa de Apoioao Empregado. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial Local – Modelo Presencial: Rodovia Raposo Tavares, km 30 e km22, Cotia/SP  Compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão: No Inventta Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Desde que começamos, lá em 1985, o mundo mudou bastante. A forma como as pessoas vivem, como elas se deslocam, como elas usam seu tempo e como interagem umas com as outras. E tudo isso também transformou a nossa forma de enxergar o mercado — deixando de ser padronizado para se tornar cada vez mais personalizado. Se cada pessoa tem sua individualidade, por que os projetos devem ser iguais? Esse olhar atento para as pessoas é o que transforma a SKR em uma empresa reconhecida por sua inovação. Desenvolvemos parcerias sólidas, como a Joint Venture com a Incorporadora Cyrela (2007), além de projetos com arquitetos renomados e fundos de investimento como CPPIB e SPX. Nos orgulhamos da referência que nos tornamos e seguimos com o propósito que definimos desde o início: entregar mais do que unidades — entregar novas formas de viver. O que buscamos: Estamos em fase de crescimento e buscamos um(a) Analista de Orçamentos para integrar o nosso time! Você será responsável por: Analisar projetos e realizar levantamentos quantitativos com base em projetos em diversas etapas de desenvolvimento; Elaborar estimativas de custo e orçamentos de obra, desde o lançamento até o orçamento executivo para início de execução; Analisar composições de custo unitário e curva ABC de insumos e serviços; Solicitar cotações a fornecedores e equalizar propostas, visando obter o melhor custo-benefício; Negociar com fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, buscando as melhores condições de preço, qualidade e prazo; Realizar estudos de custo alternativos ao escopo proposto, identificando oportunidades de redução; Acompanhar o projeto durante seu desenvolvimento, garantindo entendimento do ciclo e manutenção dos critérios de levantamento quantitativo; Compor banco dedados com informações de orçamentos e obras, contribuindo para criação e análise de indicadores; Elaborar documentos auxiliares ao orçamento, como considerações, exclusões, apresentações e demais materiais necessários; Apoiar a obra quanto a dúvidas e esclarecimentos relacionados aos orçamentos elaborados; Realizar o lançamento e a gestão do orçamento no sistema (Sienge); Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega e das metas estabelecidas pela área.  Requisitos: Graduação em Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas; Experiência mínima de 5 anos com análise de orçamentos e custos na construção civil, preferencialmente em projetos residenciais de baixo/médio padrão; Capacidade de analisar dados complexos e apresentar informações de forma clara e concisa; Excel avançado; Conhecimento em Sienge (básico) e Auto CAD (intermediário).  Diferenciais: Pós-graduação na área; Conhecimento emferramentas como Autodesk Design Review, Bim Collab, Sketch Up, Revit ou demais ferramentas BIM.  Buscamos alguém com o Perfil Pessoal: Boa administração do tempo e organização; Atenção aos detalhes e comprometimento com a precisão das entregas; Boa comunicaçãoverbal e escrita; Bom relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe; Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças; Proatividade, iniciativa e dinamismo. Não admitimos qualquer forma de discriminação relativa à raça, idade, gênero, cor, nacionalidade, religião, preferência sexual, incapacidade física ou mental e/ou qualquer outra classificação protegida por leis. title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em são bernardo do campo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em sapiranga. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Consultor de energia
description:
Nova oportunidade para Consultor de energia em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Empresa O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Sobre a Função Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória. Responsabilidades Gerenciar o portfólio de energia da empresa, que inclui geração, consumo, contratos livres e regulados, de curto e longo prazo, convencionais e de autoprodução; Negociar junto a traders, comercializadoras e agentes do setor a compra e venda de energia; Monitorar e analisar o mercado de energia (Preços de curto e longo prazo, oferta e demanda, cenários hidrológicos); Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos; Acompanhar e garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor elétrico; Realizar estudos de viabilidade econômica para novos projetos energéticos (biomassa, cogeração, etc.); Atuar na gestãode riscos (crédito, exposição ao mercado de curto prazo, variação de preços); Apoiar auditorias e reportes institucionais e de sustentabilidade; Se relacionar com as instituições do setor elétrico, incluindo ANEEL, ONS, CCEE, Distribuidoras e Transmissoras de Energia; Contribuir com o planejamento orçamentário e criticar os desvios, bem como elaborar reports para o nível executivo dos resultados da área de energia; Definir com a gestão, criar e acompanhar KPIs relacionados a energia, custos e receita de energia, realizando análises e auxiliando a gestão em decisões estratégicas; Desenvolver e automatizar processos de análise de indicadores através de ferramentas avançadas (BI, Excel, ERP); Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs.  Local de atuação São Paulo/ SP  Requisitos Graduação em Engenharia (Elétrica, Energia, Produção), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Energia, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas afins Conhecimento em Integração Segurança Conhecimento em Ferramentas da qualidade Conhecimento em SAP, Power BI Vivência com autoprodução e/ou cogeração Experiência com comercialização de energia e gestão de contratos livres e regulados Conhecimento técnico em Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro (ANEEL, CCEE, ONS). Modelos de precificação (Formação do PLD, contratos indexados) Ferramentas de análise de mercado e modelagem energética Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução  Diferenciais Inglês e Espanhol avançado Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução

title: Operations director
description:
Nova oportunidade para Operations director em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:   $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:   Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.    Qualifications:   University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment  Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.  Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature Co   Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em montenegro. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em quatro barras. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Gtm builder
description:

GTM builder   You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...  You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   You Will:   • Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows  • Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning  • Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations  • Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory  • Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution  • Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems  • Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort  • Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence  • Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available  • Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable  • Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures  • Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production   You Have:   • Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly  • Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar) • Experience title: Senior data engineer
description:

Who We Are:  We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement. title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Platform engineer / devops engineer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)   Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions   Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)   Work Hours:  EST   Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)   Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role  —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers  to ship code efficiently and reliably.   You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in  day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement  .   What You’ll Do   Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)  Manage  Kubernetes environments  : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting   Support and enhance  CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)   Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”   Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)    Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)   Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)    Python scripting (mandatory)  for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)  Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)    Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)  Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌  Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌  Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌  Pure security-focused candidates ❌  Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌  ML/Data Science profiles ❌    Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India)  You = 4th key team member
