title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em bauru. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

➥ Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google Workspace; LOCAL ➥ Porto Alegre/RS CARGA HORÁRIA ➥ 40 horas semanais ➥ Das 8h às 12h e das 13h30 às 18h MODALIDADE ➥ Regime de contratação CLT ➥ Modelo de atuação presencial O QUE A COMECE OFERECE ➥ Ambiente inovador, com forte estímulo ao crescimento técnico e profissional, aprendizado contínuo e troca entre especialistas; ➥ Atuação em projetos relevantes para empresas de tecnologia em tração e maturidade, com alta complexidade tributária; ➥ Vale refeição/alimentação; ➥ Vale transporteou ajuda de custo para deslocamento; ➥ Seguro de Vida; ➥ Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (coparticipação); ➥ Espaço para experimentação, testes e evolução profissional; ➥ Free coffee ; ➥ Ambiente colaborativo; DADOS DE APOIO AO CANDIDATO ORIENTAÇÕES PARA ENVIO DO CURRÍCULO (REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO) O currículo deverá evidenciar de forma clara, objetiva e comprovável a experiência prática do candidato em rotinas fiscais complexas, com atuação direta no regime de Lucro Real, incluindo apuração, revisão crítica e validação de tributos. Serão considerados apenas currículos que atendam aos seguintes critérios: 1. DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA DA EXPERIÊNCIA TÉCNICA O candidato deve apresentar, para cada experiência profissional relevante: Nome da empresa Período de atuação Cargo ocupado Descrição objetiva das atividades executadas, com foco em: Apuração de tributos no Lucro Real Rotinas fiscais nos regimes Lucro Real, Presumido e/ou Simples Nacional Participação ativa em fechamentos fiscais mensais Revisões críticas, validações e análises de apuração tributária Atuação em ajustes fiscais (adições, exclusões, compensações) Conciliações fiscais e contábeis Interação com clientes ou áreas internas em temas fiscais relevantes Não serão considerados currículos com descrições genéricas, superficiais ou sem evidência de atuação prática. 2. COMPROVAÇÃO DE ATUAÇÃO PRÁTICA O currículo deve deixar evidente: Nível de autonomia na execução das apurações fiscais Participação direta em fechamentos fiscais completos Complexidade das empresas atendidas (porte, faturamento, volume de operações, regime tributário) Envolvimento em análises críticas, revisões técnicas ou identificação de riscos fiscais 3. REFERÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (OBRIGATÓRIO) O candidato deverá informar, no mínimo, 3 referências profissionais diretas, vinculadas à sua atuação técnica. Cada referência deve conter obrigatoriamente: Nome da empresa Nome completo do contato Cargo do contato Relação profissional com o candidato (ex: gestor direto, sócio, cliente, líder técnico, etc.) E-mail corporativo Telefone para contato As referências poderão ser contatadas durante o processo seletivo para validação técnica, nível de autonomia e qualidade das entregas realizadas. 4. DIFERENCIAL RELEVANTE Será considerado diferencial: Experiência com empresas no Lucro Real em ambientes de maior complexidade operacional Atuação em revisão e estruturação de processos fiscais Experiência com análise de riscos fiscais e contingências Participação em discussões de planejamento tributário Experiência com cruzamentos de dados fiscais, contábeis e financeiros Vivência com ferramentas tecnológicas, automações ou BI aplicados ao contexto fiscal IMPORTANTE Esta vaga é direcionada a profissionais com domínio técnico real, experiência prática comprovada e alto nível de autonomia no regime de Lucro Real. Não buscamos profissionais com atuação apenas operacional ou suporte parcial. Buscamos profissionais com capacidade de analisar, revisar, validar e sustentar tecnicamente as apurações fiscais, atuando como referência dentro do time e junto aos clientes. Currículos que não atendam aos critérios acima poderão ser desconsiderados automaticamente.

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior voip engineer em toledo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

description:

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

description:

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)  Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)  Work Hours:  EST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)  Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)   Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”   Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)    Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)   Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)    Python scripting (mandatory)  for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)  Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)    Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)  Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌  Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌  Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌  Pure security-focused candidates ❌  Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌  ML/Data Science profiles ❌    Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India)  You = 4th key team member

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior voip engineer em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em barretos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.  The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.  Financial   ● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.  ● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.  ● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates  ● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.  ● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients  ● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients  ● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions  Operational   ● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.  ● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.  ● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.  ● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.  Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Senior data engineer
description:

Who We Are:  We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals. The 3 G’s of RE:   “Get Shit Done.” “Get Over Shit.” “Give a Shit.” What You’ll Do:   Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.  Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.  Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.  Ensure data quality and reliability.  Innovate and follow best practices.  Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.  O que você fará   Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em santana de parnaíba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em criciúma. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior business analyst - supply chain em esteio. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). description:

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. title: Investment banking intern
description:
Empresa está contratando Investment banking intern em itapecerica da serra. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:

Sobre a empresaPrazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos. Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM. Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas: QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃO Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos. Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos. A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família. Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal. Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher. A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil. Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos. Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena. ResponsabilidadesPlanejar, programar e controlar a produção, garantindo o atendimento da demanda com eficiência Elaborar e acompanhar o forecast de produção junto ao comercialo (PMP) Gerenciar níveis de estoque de matérias-primas e produtos acabados Analisar capacidade produtiva e propor melhorias de fluxo Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (OTIF, giro de estoque, lead time, etc.) Atuar em conjunto com compras, logística e produção para alinhamento de demandas Identificar gargalos e propor soluções para otimização de processos  RequisitosFormação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas Experiência sólida em PCP, preferencialmente na indústria de alimentos ou bens de consumo Conhecimento no sistemas ERP TOTVS Protheus Excel avançado (desejável conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas) Experiência com controle de estoque e planejamento de demanda Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa capacidade de comunicação  DiferenciaisExperiência no segmento de alimentos saudáveis ou perecíveis Vivência em ambientes com alta variabilidade de demanda  Nível da vagaPleno ou Sênior (de acordo com experiência e senioridade do candidato) Benefícios(Preencher conforme política da empresa) Vale alimentação/refeição Vale transporte Convênio Farmácia PLR (Outros benefícios)  Por que trabalhar com a gente?Aqui você fará parte de uma empresa em crescimento, com propósito claro de promover saúde através da alimentação, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

description:

Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países.  Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas.  Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento. Responsabilidades    Supervisionar diariamente no sistema da Receita Federal a existência de novos pedidos de embarque, acionando as áreas envolvidas e tomando as medidas necessárias;  Supervisionar o time quanto à documentação emitida a fim de evitar embarques incorretos;  Manter contato permanente com clientes externos e internos (nacional e internacional), avaliando a necessidade de correções de documentos e providenciando-os, a fim de manter os padrões exigidos pela legislação evitando penalidades e multas perante as alfândegas brasileira e do exterior;  Manter contato com o departamento de controle das filiais a fim de acompanhar as coletas (exportação) e entregas (importação) e posicionar Brink's e clientes quanto aos embarques cuja contratação é "porta a porta";  Supervisionar atividades administrativas como conferências e pagamento de frete aéreo internacional e valores a serem faturados;  Conhecer e interpretar os Inconterms (negociações entre importador e exportador) e providenciar instruções de emissão de documentos de acordo com o Incoterm negociado;  Seguir procedimentos internos de segurança e sigilo da informação;  Manter o cliente devidamente informado de todos os passos/acontecimentos do processo;  Participar dos programas de melhoria contínua e disseminar novas propostas de processos junto ao time. title: Investment banking intern
description:
Empresa está contratando Investment banking intern em praia grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps)  Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)  Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now!  If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Chief technology officer - cto
description:
Confira a vaga para Chief technology officer - cto em blumenau. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Purpose of the Position   The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading Saa S platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.  More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.  Main Challenges and Assignments   Modernize without disruption:  Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle +. NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.  Act as the Integrator of the EOS model:  Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.  Professionalize the technology organization:  Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.  Build cohesion and leadership depth:  Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.  Sustain high performance and growth:  Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.  Influence and earn autonomy:  Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.  Drive engagement and culture:  Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.  Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders:  Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.  Prepare for scale and possible M&A:  Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.    Experience and Professional Qualifications   Technology leadership:  Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in Saa S, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.  Transformation delivery:  Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).  Systems architecture expertise  : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (. NET Framework,. NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).  Operational excellence:  Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).  Process & governance:  Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.  Stakeholder management:  Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.  Team scaling & culture:  Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.  Language:  Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.  Education:  Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.    Behavioral Skills   Ownership & Accountability  – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.  Transparent & Courageous Communication  – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.  Learning Agility & Adaptability  – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.  Executive Presence with Simplicity  – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.  Collaborative Influence  – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Operations director
description:
Empresa está contratando Operations director em chapecó. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:   $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:   Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.    Qualifications:   University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment  Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.  Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Cx analista de monitoria - vaga exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência
description:

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99 Pay). Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da Di Di Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a Di Di está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados. Sobre a vaga Estamos procurando um(a) Monitor(a) de Garantia da Qualidade para se juntar à nossa equipe! Neste cargo, você será um guardião fundamental da experiência do nosso cliente, responsável por garantir nossos padrões de qualidade e a satisfação do cliente. Você executará o lado operacional da qualidade, revisando as interações com os clientes e identificando oportunidades de eficiência para o negócio, gerando um impacto direto na vida de milhares de pessoas. Se você tem um olhar aguçado para detalhes, paixão pela excelência e quer começar sua carreira em um ambiente que valoriza insights baseados em dados, este é o lugar para você. Responsabilidades Avaliar a Excelência: Monitorar e revisar as interações com os clientes em canais escritos, chat ao vivo e chamadas telefônicas para garantir que atendam aos nossos padrões de serviço de classe mundial. Auditar com Precisão: Usar checklists padronizados para verificar se todos os procedimentos foram seguidos corretamente, atribuindo pontos e deduzindo nota por falhas quando necessário. Fornecer Feedback Significativo: Adicionar comentários claros e construtivos às suas avaliações para ajudar os agentes a entenderem seu desempenho e áreas de desenvolvimento. Garantir o Alinhamento: Participar de sessões de calibração semanais com Líderes de Equipe (Team Leads) e colegas para garantir que suas avaliações permaneçam consistentes e justas. Identificar Tendências: Procurar ativamente por padrões ou erros recorrentes durante suas avaliações para ajudar a equipe a identificar lacunas nos processos ou no treinamento. Colaborar: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com sua equipe e reportar-se diretamente ao seu Líder de Equipe/Supervisor para atingir as metas diárias de produtividade e qualidade.  Requisitos e Qualificações Formação Acadêmica: Ensino superior (bacharelado) ou curso técnico concluído ou em andamento. Idioma: Espanhol ou Inglês é um diferencial (plus). A "Mentalidade de QA": Você possui um forte senso de negócios e uma natureza inquisitiva. Você não vê apenas um erro; você quer entender o que o causou. Base Analítica: Você se sente confortável trabalhando com dados estruturados e tem proficiência básica em Excel. Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita; você consegue articularfeedbacks complexos de uma forma que seja fácil de entender. Adaptabilidade: Você prospera em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado e consegue se adaptar rapidamente aos padrões e à cultura da empresa. Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente ou ambiente de contact center. Familiaridade com sistemas de tickets ou plataformas de CRM, como Zendesk ou Salesforce. Conhecimento básico de metodologias de melhoria contínua ou frameworks de QA (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.).  You'll love working at 99 because Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar. Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a Di Di. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo. Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso. Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.  Diversidade e Inclusão Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99 Adapta, 99 Afro, 99 Cores, 99 Mulheres e 99 Famílias. Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer. Reconheço que, antes de enviar esta inscrição, li e aceitei o Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos, disponível em  Didiglobal. Com/terms

Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Requisitos e Qualificações   Formação Acadêmica: Ensino superior (bacharelado) ou curso técnico concluído ou em andamento.  Idioma: Espanhol ou Inglês é um diferencial (plus). Base Analítica: Você se sente confortável trabalhando com dados estruturados e tem proficiência básica em Excel.  Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita; você consegue articular feedbacks complexos de uma forma que seja fácil de entender.  Adaptabilidade: Você prospera em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado e consegue se adaptar rapidamente aos padrões e à cultura da empresa.  Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente ou ambiente de contact center.  Familiaridade com sistemas de tickets ou plataformas de CRM, como Zendesk ou Salesforce. Conhecimento básico de metodologias de melhoria contínua ou frameworks de QA (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.). Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.  Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.  Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a Di Di. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.  Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99 Adapta, 99 Afro, 99 Cores, 99 Mulheres e 99 Famílias.
