No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.   Totalpass:  para você cuidar da sua qualidade de vida, saúde e bem-estar.  ﻿Kit escolar  com preços acessíveis (para você garantir materiais de qualidade e com custo benefício.  Pet Love:  Para cuidar também do seu filho de quatro patas, incluímos um benefício especial para mais esse membro da sua família  Quem Somos    Ficamos felizes de te ver por aqui!   Na VAMOS, acreditamos que gente é o nosso maior diferencial. Somos um ecossistema que transforma o transporte e a mobilidade com inovação, simplicidade e propósito — tudo isso pautado em valores sólidos, alinhados aos pilares de ESG e, agora, fortalecidos pelo nosso novo olhar estratégico: SIM+PAR  .  O SIM+PAR  representa a forma como queremos avançar em 2026:  SIM  de simplificar, somar e seguir juntos.  PAR  de parceria, protagonismo e propósito.  É essa combinação que impulsiona nossas decisões, nossa cultura e nossa forma de fazer — sempre com foco no que realmente importa: as pessoas.  Aqui, você encontra oportunidades reais de crescimento, desenvolvimento e protagonismo. Trabalhamos com a inclusão de grupos sub-representados e valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Nossas vagas são para todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Queremos talentos que compartilhem nossa paixão pelo cliente, nosso foco em resultados e nossa vontade de construir o futuro com simplicidade e colaboração.  Nossos valores nos movem:   • Cliente  : É a razão da nossa existência.  • Gente  : É o que nos torna únicos.  • Simplicidade  : Ser simples para ser ágil.  • Atitude de dono  : Se fosse meu, eu faria melhor.  • Sustentabilidade  : Cada atitude conta.  • Lucro  : É missão de todos — para crescer e seguir inovando.  E agora, com o SIM+PAR  , reforçamos nossa ambição de fazer ainda mais e melhor: agir com propósito, fortalecer parcerias, acelerar movimentos e construir, juntos, um ecossistema cada vez mais humano, eficiente e conectado.  Se você acredita que pode fazer a diferença e quer construir sua jornada em um ambiente colaborativo, seguro e cheio de oportunidades, VAMOS juntos e juntas  . Porque aqui, gente é o nosso negócio  .

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical recruiter (remote) em são josé do rio preto. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Reboot Monkey   Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents  . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.  We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  About the Role   Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.  As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania  , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician  . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.  This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT  or managed DCTs directly  . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management.  What You'll Do   Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region   Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords   Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score   Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history   Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria   Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training   Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team   Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region   Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them   Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings    Requirements   3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)   Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills   Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring   Fluent written and spoken English   Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision   Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical recruiter (remote) em suzano. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Reboot Monkey   Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents  . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.  We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  About the Role   Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.  As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania  , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician  . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.  This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT  or managed DCTs directly  . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management.  What You'll Do   Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region   Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords   Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score   Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history   Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria   Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training   Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team   Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region   Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them   Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings    Requirements   3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)   Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills   Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring   Fluent written and spoken English   Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision   Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical recruiter (remote) em barueri. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Reboot Monkey   Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents  . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.  We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  About the Role   Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.  As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania  , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician  . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.  This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT  or managed DCTs directly  . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management.  What You'll Do   Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region   Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords   Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score   Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history   Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria   Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training   Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team   Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region   Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them   Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings    Requirements   3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)   Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills   Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring   Fluent written and spoken English   Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision   Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Compliance specialist, compliance & communications
description:
Empresa está contratando Compliance specialist, compliance & communications em osasco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Compliance Specialist to join the Compliance & Communications team within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role supports compliance oversight across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs, ensuring that partners operate in accordance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements. In this role, you will assess partner compliance, develop scalable audit mechanisms, drive a compliance culture across our network, and generate actionable insights through structured reporting. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about compliance, risk reduction, and making a meaningful impact, come join our team. Key job responsibilities- Conduct partner audits across Amazon Partner Logistic programs to verify compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements - Develop and maintain audit execution plans, tracking compliance scores, non-conformities, and corrective action plans - Generate structured compliance reports including audit adherence, action plan adherence, and operational standards adherence - Investigate non-compliant partner activity and prepare audit reports with findings and recommendations - Develop scalable compliance mechanisms: SOPs, written guidance, training programs, and internal review processes - Deliver audit findings to partners and coordinate with internal teams (Legal, Operations, Procurement) on corrective actions - Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on Last Mile operations - Identify compliance gaps, root causes, and practical recommendations to mitigate risks proactively - Maintain accurate records of audit activities, compliance status, and follow-up actions - Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance the overall compliance programA day in the lifeYour day starts by reviewing the compliance monitoring queue: checking flagged partner activities, pending audit follow-ups, and opening corrective action items across Partner Logistics programs. Later, you lead a call with a partner to walk through audit findings, discussing non-conformities and aligning on a corrective action plan. You update the audit execution report with scores, compliance status, and next steps. Then, you collaborate with Legal and Operations to refine a compliance SOP and review the weekly adherence dashboard: tracking audit adherence rates, action plan completion, and operational standards performance across the network. Every day brings a mix of investigation, stakeholder engagement, process building, and data-driven reporting.About the teamThe Compliance & Communications team is part of Amazon Logistics’ Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMXL (Amazon Extra Large), and AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate in full compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. We develop scalable audit mechanisms, generate actionable compliance insights, and drive partner engagement through strategic communications. The team sits within a broader Strategic structure that also covers Pricing, Payments & Incentives, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross-functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS    - Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent- Experience handling confidential information- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities- Experience working with a cross functional team- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbalPREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS    - Experience in SQL data manipulation- Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques- Experience working in risk/fraud analysis or in compliance organizations- Experience in logistics- Experience in auditing, risk management, compliance, program management, or quality management systems- Experience creating training programs or compliance communication materials
